'''9000''' ('''nine thousand''') is the natural number following [[8000 (number)#890 to 8999|
8999]] and preceding 9001.

== Selected numbers in the range 9001–9999==
<!-- Do not speak of anything of, which pertains to or relates anywhere to, the "Over 9000" meme -->

===9001 to 9099===
* '''9001''' – [[sexy prime]] with 9007
* '''9007''' – sexy prime with 9001
* '''9009''' – [[centered cube number]]<ref>{{cite OEIS|A005898|Centered cube numbers: n^3 + (n+1)^3.}}</ref>
* '''9025''' = [[95 (number)|95]]<sup>2</sup>, [[centered octagonal number]]
* '''9029''' – [[Sophie Germain prime]]
* '''9041''' – [[super-prime]]
* '''9045''' – [[triangular number]]
* '''9059''' – Sophie Germain prime
* '''9072''' – [[decagonal number]]
* '''9077''' – [[Markov number]]<ref>{{cite OEIS|A002559|	Markoff (or Markov) numbers: union of positive integers x, y, z satisfying x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 3*x*y*z.}}</ref>
* '''9091''' – [[unique prime]]<ref>{{cite OEIS|A040017|		Prime 3 followed by unique period primes (the period r of 1/p is not shared with any other prime) of the form A019328(r)/gcd(A019328(r),r) in order (periods r are given in A051627).}}</ref>
